findings.reason: Verified: UsernameForm.java:47 calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, and the only declaration in the repo is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel), so the services module fails to compile.

Verified: the original fillContextForm call sat in the user==null branch, but the new predicate requires user != null, so passkeys are dropped from the first login page, and the PR's own tests expect the webauth form after oauth.openLoginForm() with no user set.

The test does disable passkeys realm-wide, so it never exercises a password-only user with realm passkeys on; the predicate would show the form there (WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators returns false and never checks the user's credentials), so the gap is real, but it is a test gap and the try/fail style suggestion is marginal.
